entities.title: fix-network
entities.summary: A command-line tool that diagnoses and repairs a Mac's network: link, public internet, VPN, routing, corporate DNS and services, and proxies. One Rust binary, three modes: diagnose, fix and a quick status.
entities.purpose: The crate of the fix-network binary: Cargo.toml, the user README, and the sources in src/. It is one member of the Cargo workspace in src/macos and builds one binary.
boundaries: It stands alone: it uses no other tool in the repository, and nothing in the repository's code calls it. The agent skill in agents/skills/fix-network tells coding agents how to run it.
Building, testing in CI and publishing the binary are the workspace's and the continuous_integration_and_delivery repository's concern, not this folder's.
